title: Establish 'What Changed' micro-changelogs and gated stakeholder signoff workflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable process that produces short, audience-tailored 'What changed' blurbs for every release component and enforces a gated stakeholder signoff before publishing customer-facing changelogs.

Background: Longer release notes and single monolithic changelogs are hard to consume; support and sales want 1-2 line summaries for customers, devs want technical bulleted deltas, and executives want a one-sentence impact statement. We will produce three micro-changelog outputs per feature: Exec, Admin/Customer, and Dev. Each micro-changelog will live in the release checklist, be linked to PRs and evaluation tests, and pass through a lightweight signoff workflow (PM -> Eng lead -> Design -> Support).

Scope: Iterate process and templates for the upcoming console-2026.03 release. Deliverables: micro-changelog templates, Slack signoff bot that records approvals to the release doc, a short internal brief for SRE/support with rollback guidance, and a published customer changelog entry that is Gated (only published after approvals and redaction checks).
acceptance_criteria: Three short micro-changelog formats created: executive (<=25 words), customer/admin (1-2 sentences), developer (3-5 technical bullets)
Automated signoff flow (Slack button or lightweight form) records approvals from PM, Eng lead, and Support and appends timestamp to release doc
Published customer-facing changelog entry is generated from approved micro-changelog and appears on docs.redwood.ai/changelog with proper redactions
Internal SRE/support brief produced and attached to the release checklist with clear rollback steps and observability dashboards
Each micro-changelog links to at least one authoritative artifact (GitHub PR, Confluence doc, or evaluation dashboard)
tasks: Draft micro-changelog templates for Exec/Admin/Dev (owner: PM)
Create a lightweight signoff workflow prototype in Slack (owner: Eng automation)
Add redaction checklist items and PII scan to publish step (owner: Security)
Populate release checklist for console-2026.03 with micro-changelogs for top 12 features (owner: PM)
Run 1 pilot publish for a non-customer-impacting feature and capture feedback (owner: Support + PM)
Finalize publish script to push approved micro-changelogs to docs site and email digest (owner: Docs)
Post-mortem / feedback capture after pilot and iterate templates (owner: PM)
Train on-call/support on new internal brief format (owner: Support)
Lock gating policy into release checklist (owner: PM + Legal for compliance review if necessary)
